messages:
sara: Heads up — Arcturus Labs EAP kickoff. NDA signed by legal last night. Need bench plan + infra access list. Timeline: 4-week alpha starting Mon 04/07. @pranav can you lead benchmarks? @liz infra for access.

pranav: On it. I'll sketch a benchmark matrix: throughput, p99, memory, perf vs q8, and power draw. Will we run our standard 'inference-core' suite or custom?

liz: We need subnet + static IPs for their lab to reach our private collector. Also SSH bastion + vault access for keys. @nate can you prepare AMIs for arcturus-rt images.

nate: I'll build AMIs. Question: do we need mixed-precision kernels compiled for their silicon? If so, need toolchain from Arcturus.

ben: We agreed partner will provide cross-compile toolchain under NDA. Elaine from partnerships coordinating handoff. Also need marketplace packaging checklist for later.

elaine: Arcturus sent toolchain S3 link and sample model zip. I've uploaded to shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/arcturus/toolchain-v1 . NDA reminder: don't share outside the project channel. :lock:

pranav: Thanks. Initial bench plan draft:

- suites: latency_single, qps_batched(1..16), kv-cache-hit-rate
- metrics: p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, mem-usage, energy (where provided)
- scripts: `run_bench.sh --suite arcturus-alpha`
I'll post a PR for script + dashboards.

liz: Access checklist:
- VPC peering w/ arcturus-lab
- Bastion + jump user
- Vault role: arcturus-eap
- Telemetry forwarder config (sampling=0.1)
I'll open tickets.

deploy-bot: Agreement document uploaded to legal-drive: https://legal.redwood.ai/agreements/arcturus-eap.pdf

sara: Can we keep sampling low initially to avoid data movement costs. Pranav, include a smoke run that exercises full-length contexts and toolchain path.

pranav: Will do. Also want to try a quantization sweep (int8/q4/q8) if toolchain supports. Need to record model outputs for regression.

elaine: Arcturus asks for two progress demos: week1 integration + week3 perf summary. They're also open to a joint blog if numbers look good.

liz: FYI our compliance team flagged export control on one of their components. Elaine, can you confirm export paperwork cleared?

elaine: Checked — export paperwork in drive (export-decl.pdf). Marked as restricted. Please don't copy.

ben: Marketplace note: if EAP goes well we should prep a 'Arcturus-Optimized' listing. I'll draft the marketplace metadata template (icons, SKU, pricing guidance).

nate: ETA for AMIs: 2 business days. I need the kernel module from Arcturus to build optimized package.

pranav: I'll run baseline tomorrow and post initial numbers in #bench-results. Quick ask: whoever spins infra please tag bench-run with the test-id.

sara: Great. Action items: @pranav bench plan + PR by EOD; @liz infra tickets + access by EOD tomorrow; @nate AMIs in 48h; @ben marketplace template draft next week; @elaine coordinate demos and compliance. :thumbsup:

pranav: Ack. I'll also add a small eval harness to compare output fidelity across quant levels.

liz: Created infra tickets: INF-4521, INF-4522, INF-4523. Links: https://todo.redwood.ai/INF-4521

pranav: Posted PR: https://git.redwood.ai/bench/compare/arcturus-eap

sara: Thanks team. We'll sync in weekly partnerships standup. Closing thread for now. :rocket:
